verdict.rationale: Google's own documentation describes an optional Privacy Screen that requires device verification (PIN, pattern or biometric prompt) before the app can be used, which directly delivers the story's app-lock. Support rests on a single brief first-party mention, and the lock uses the device's own credential rather than an app-specific PIN. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detail on lock behavior (timeout, platform availability), and an app-specific PIN option.
